scope: Live four-camera responsiveness, exact serial assignment, source-clock progress and numeric/media consistency. Airflow jitter has no physical ground-truth rotation oracle. Advertised FPS alone is not a latency measurement.

camera_binding.edit: set fields.rust_camera_id to the exact hardware ID from camera_list; empty unlinks
camera_binding.missing_or_duplicate: rig does not start; never substitutes another camera or sample

discovery.execution: GUI-thread config edits are immediate. Worker commands return queued:true. Poll status until frames/revision/paused/recording/notice confirm the requested change; queued is not completion. Each native session closes independently, including the first window. discard:true discards only the selected session's unsaved edits. The application exits after the last session closes.
discovery.interactive_recording: raw, debug or both; explicit empty selection is rejected; default raw

discard.description: Native GUI explicit discard of unsaved config edits; headless sessions are disposable in-memory state

enabled.description: Pace source processing to video timestamps; headless applies during explicit step/run, native applies to the worker
